notes.title: Update Notes (0.2.0-p2)
notes.notes:
This build fixes multiple issues discovered during the playtest. The playtest will close on October 21st, so be sure to give it a try if you are interested.

[h2]Features[/h2]

- Added the "Bomb Economy" achievement, awarded for getting the Waterworks artifact without detonating any naval mines.

[h2]Changes/Improvements[/h2]

- Updated Unity version to 2022.3.47f1.
- Fixed some issues with controller navigation on level select.
- Fixed a display issue with the menu background when changing areas in level select after beating a vault level.
- The lose screen now shows different pictures in the Waterworks vault.
- The win screen now shows a different animation in the Waterworks vault.
- Fixed a glitch where waterfall particles could briefly appear in the wrong place after waterfalls reached water.
- Fixed an error that caused Waterworks level 18 to fail to load.
- The pause menu will now properly go through its exit transition in vault levels.
- Fix an issue that was causing Legion and Goji to sometimes fail to shake the camera when they should shake it.
- Fixed the position of a respawn point in the Grand Entry vault that wasn't aligned to the grid.
- Legion will no longer continue their normal attacks during the vault end sequence.
- The big pig ball in the Legion end sequence will no longer disappear when the screen starts to fade to black.
- Added a waterfall to the Waterworks background.
- Fixed a glitch where entering the Waterworks vault through the door would cause a softlock.
- Fixed a glitch where Goji wasn't doing anything after restarting the Waterworks vault from the checkpoint.
- The camera will no longer move rapidly when restarting the Waterworks vault from the checkpoint.
- Reduced the difficulty of the third section of the Waterworks vault.
- Fixed a glitch where Goji's waterfall would play its sound at full volume when it shouldn't.
- Fixed unfair respawns that were possible after Mr. Stretch is hit by Goji's waterfall attack.
- Fixed goal block pointer not appearing on the HUD during the final phase of the Waterworks vault.
- Fixed some minor visual issues with the "See more" button that appears when a Tip links to a Journal page.
